title: Dead Trainz links: 7 pointed to the live page of the same item, 553 cleared (Master Version 2.85)
rule: Every Trainz address on every master tab was fetched on 2026-11-07 (13,090 links + 715 parts-diagram pages). A link answering 404 is replaced ONLY by a live Trainz page whose Model Number equals the row's item number AND whose title/description is the same item (colour, finish, part vs whole); otherwise the link is cleared. A link inside a Notes cell is removed with its 'Trainz:' label; the note's words stay. Cells are keyed by Row ID (Lionel Parts has none: item number + the exact old cell); sheet rows are hints.
stated: Brad 2026-11-07 06:34 CT "i want to test the wish list and all the trainz links so that i can present trainz" → 09:58 "yes" (fix the dead links) → 10:22 "yes" to the plan (live page where the same item exists, else clear; row-by-row list first; weekly check to the crawl chat) → 10:43 "Approve inserting the master version" (the write).
